title: Rock Island Railroad, Utica Passenger Depot, East of Clark Street, North of Grove Street, Utica, La Salle County, IL
notes: Significance: Built mid-nineteenth century, the Utica station is one of the oldest surviving depots built by the Chicago, Rock Island & Pacific Railroad.
